body:
## Features

- Add "tmp" and "xmp_original" to excluded extensions of the md5 list fixer (PR #3393) (1356640530493e79d7eb18a289687c73e1e4c0cd), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Make menus on macOS more conventional (PR #3447) (a6938e1eb32708f0757e2d9fccea924bc3b77fd8), thanks @rapture-party!
- Add setting to overwrite conversion destination file (issue #3482) (c65da3f345251bc3fd0fa31d2e0cbd9bb87f3985)
- Add and manage search history (issue #3513) (887f23729647a77a30ed3abf391b21a1e53d4a7f, 01288c516a77be3911357c94942222814e2377d3, 71f577307ecf1777a769702d9309518a1eb8b5e7)
- Add support for "contributor" tag on e621 (issue #3522, PR #3536) (1cdead88eebd1ead1788b7ba9a616f6a77f3cee1), thanks @PencilVoid!
- Add Chinese traditional translation (PR #3468) (0535b50a77444eb32662cdb4caec01219fb4de9a), thanks @VM8gkAs!
- Allow cookie import in source settings (issue #3364) (ece0f58325279a655b65c8c950ea021b558c69e4)
- Enable WebView support (issue #3366 and issue #3540) (78eb8017b49dffddf73a22e7b1b4f18d2c923c7a, e794d76ca4c37b9e535dfeae0dc75209fa5a0ee8, f3fba80cc3ac7502a4e581d19a7236750486dab0)
- Add backup restore support for settings, favorites, lists, monitors, history, MD5 data, filename history, thumbnails, and web services (issue #583) (eca878f74bd8d658d21dc37a1b6d07afd24ed64b, 8a998ad241493071cc8f7c7e596bd9a6d6c5a763, 64af311b8dc33e45e3e673955bafd99c4be1022d, f0828c697a35558cc0cf5d3a45bdf346d11e3ff7, fe0db9aead06624bbf811e0c8f6d4ffef21bf95a, 729f45b5f99095f2f974caf93aa52516cb07f9df, 18b3143fb814294f9eadb591579cc310df37a07a, 6050a4d3ed402cdf8c4dd9d144ae39b2cf485f0b, 2c213b2a6d200c206e20069dea872fac07da7b56, 64ff202fa070c80cecec74aa53455e3ac448c80b, b95545b03cfbfb0ad8948869b263a8b44fc9e35e, 18b49959621ce52b583125ddafefcf43641e2901, 9e4f5a520034420cfaba7a1a09cc9e8279fa87e3, cf146fbf55f5f47ce26a1fcd0f545ccfcca4b62a)
- Allow customizing extension rotation (issue #3591) (e6879071d0084485bcd895c29cb0aceeadb28ac6)
- Add setting to show video indicator on thumbnails (32107c563c23f76f145e2d93f12118a7aedfb8b3)
- Add move/delete buttons for conditionals (issue #3622) (1f36c51826bbfd7f3b6e21287636efcb099b0a83)
- Allow customizing backend for each image conversion (ae6ab57c8d78e03ef5fe91c650c64c3d8b7e015c)
- Add site-specific blacklist shortcut (PR #3671) (62028beddb0b33c24d144bed6d035b7c9e3ee774), thanks @yami-no-tusbas!
- Add "add tabs" menu (issue #3649) (4e4df931dea9db7e5762cd3a8d38a9d3cd3d469a)
- Set filename/path overrides when converting download to monitor (issue #3400) (adfddbd8fe4a64bb4896a8e5ae665fbb26fe46ff)

## Fixes

- Improve light/dark theme colors and favorites/KFL styling (PR #3359 and issue #3435) (da3559ba613c1fd1e41902ab3c131ba223f5104a, 3ec1d94347b54d9ae9890206b9f1440316eb54d1), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Keep batch download order when converting to monitor (issue #3397) (15c5ee026809f3dbe2bad18716dbc6c913451b48)
- Properly detect nightly in lib project (issue #3399) (b00ff766669a0bf6c40a05ec68007b3e8b1ab3d1)
- Use pixel sizing consistently for viewer images and result/favorite thumbnails (issue #3410 and issue #3405) (c2a341c8d0cc5661255cd9468f39b8a20867c3a8, 0320f6e059ada2c1c83c5a364aff9bc8647075d1, 66e0949d1c4f0b4a9845711c49207f659f65c692)
- Exclude JSON files from ugoira frames (issue #3483) (9057d9161934507ecb52af3130737a34f869ed5e)
- Use configured limit value for monitors (issue #3486) (0c338165922eaa4e2b42f518a39ae20f0627d64a)
- Remove line breaks when pasting into search field (issue #3469) (30858e6213f08b639c912f301fb85a00ed760dc6)
- Remove suffix log files when deleting from UI (issue #3562) (145d31922729a31d253ffaa57bf40744e50e2f69)
- Don't double line breaks in wordsc.txt (21c267e1d747d4e91835ba8a794202e333c9c78b)
- Fix search-history handling for galleries (issue #3513) (accc9d39b31e9b2cc4cb3f0fff7ca2ea9552a5c2)
- Don't re-sort auto-complete when nothing was added (eb7e46c4e7aa7cb9cfb955c5852677527ade3a99)
- Fix crash when editing a favorite with a monitor (issue #3598) (223cadf76fb4f073a2c45b364a24da0b50572cd5)
- Don't crash when closing the image window (issue #3599) (7b1e19d5052e42e9a779405018bfa8ad603007a7)
- Encode APNG files with format=rgba in ffmpeg (PR #3601) (09144184e71e7704f758c29149065cb46fe82d1a), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Don't HTML-escape logged URLs (PR #3613) (a4c80d5db9b1f433eddb97ce844dc603b573b3c6), thanks @GiovanH!
- Crop auto-converted videos to even sizes (PR #3603) (30f59d1bb79d05d6369a12a2485b73177423c937), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Save "Show video indicator on previews" setting (issue #3611) (a33e950c6acb8eef64d1ae1710bc8ee932923c81)
- Allow removing headers from site settings (c4f76020125007ea4c78d89f78a7a00152bf63d2)
- Properly parse ISO 8601 dates (5277180bf459c6760ff361a786af8e8c181e0595)
- Use page/details referer by default for preview/images (issue #3660) (e36d258517d119f2e909101044e8e00bd07c923e)
- Ensure open in new tab works for tags in image viewer window (PR #3673) (7b67f6cdfff55687f5bc52511f650562cb4af367), thanks @pappnu!
- Thumbnail computation with null size part (61a22c8bd08318eefc00c97538b7bfc1866b6e53)
- Move macOS resources to the Contents/Resources/ directory (9c0d903bcb484fa028f80158df2d7a13cc898786)

## Sources

- Fix thumbs and images subdomain for NH (issue #3372) (d3fa93015d0af1bba75be8dee90d5b0868e0782d)
- Fix E-Hentai gallery, thumbnail, disowned-gallery, and tag parsing (issue #3390, issue #3574, and issue #3573) (18f54d622756c561d28df84689c4d53e3019cb47, e6785ea1be91b1329cb09ea7cbfee946f921a402, def50bbe053c02664be13e56722e2140ab6b091c, 2dd94ddf3b78890558a87f5c2de2eea369e5b1f6), thanks @OtZer0!
- Add light support for lefty.pictures (issue #3389) (b15d5638c58ebc4a3cffca4f46fbf7484250d1a8)
- Fix Gelbooru page parsing, regressions, content visibility, API errors, and typed-tag defaults (PR #3495, PR #3662, and issue #3654) (bf8dbf8f584dc60f55006f1cc84571697df76580, acb8f6ac63cd9d170b155e8e73b1ec49711bdb49, 8749120987e2d8da70ded9a8167864bb1e313fba, 4e69f49485db72164123eac61ac039a9ee42b574, 61b778af31af5502b5afb79099343590f70111ff, 55a7f506ffe3fe5fa7de059c8b5303eecd9c3ff3), thanks @ProtagNeptune and @ShugokiFable!
- Improve Rule34.xxx favorites, details API, and default source order (PR #3620 and PR #3641) (86dea94e9f29ae4812c1bda595d8e0344e7f21ee, 7d5eedce10d4d4038013d06e7d8700bf7400396f, 8278f4b9e8f57dbfabf24d291a9076575ee3ad83, 3495e082468fd2e579a04f9e643316ea44204b95), thanks @hhesrdf and @CalamitousFelicitousness!
- Fix HTML tag parsing on multiple sources (issue #3411) (6c949cfa7cf965dd855893fd8670b739b80e571c)
- Add range url param for FurAffinity (PR #3515) (74427929b411dc8fcd0ec2dd87ebe4e963b8709d), thanks @renfald!
- Fix Kemono domain name (issue #3596) (5a724e07f6be4ca2e930bf4fc1e449f468202335)
- Use V2 API for E621 (PR #3646) (edf022bc028375b43288752e5a692394d4361935), thanks @yami-no-tusbas!
- Add support for million in tag counts (issue #3635) (f7629f4281f8d4cf55bd3446b8f7ae950114f0dc)
- Set a dynamic User-Agent for Danbooru (571998ffc23167d2765d7b109b97077c074794b5)
- Detect Cosbooru as Danbooru 2.0 (issue #3650) (fea2e67d80b786259c4fec404180a25aaf55587a)
- Fix paheal thumbnail parsing (issue #3544) (87729b8a4e5bcb21e2dd952a760aeed7c7667e7e)
- Always use PNG for previews on anime-pictures.net (PR #3680) (ca467b4e87d0c20944a0e8b01d8e2d1deed2e4f3), thanks @adem4ik!

## Android

- Allow to control QML galleries with arrows (issue #3387) (832e53a3c65d7be2a604f95e1fe8b60a16c91b19)
- Add global added tags and post filters (issue #3428) (fcc7a2bfe4973647dbaac26e71ae24f4bfb9aab3)
- Use proper version numbers for QtMultimedia (issue #3273) (5191e540e706cec4092b5cce4aaa26778e9d56a8)
- Fix and debounce file sharing (issue #3479 and issue #3580) (8b93d416cba917ff133c03ad41811ac3006a2f16, b8f5ea95ffbbbb25a063c8f2b14fa93fd28ce8c3)
- Add pre-load setting on the mobile version (issue #3510) (80e500cf2746be92fffb3afde75697bd245511d8)
- Make pinch-to-zoom work on mobile (issue #3509) (dcbd3073bbea6b8b69438dfc87d26ab275999641)
- Improve tag views, colors, and styling across themes (issue #3514) (740c48c9d690bbc65e6c586cf436f6f77662fb8f, e5ed54aeb77471ea23713058e38bd4234cf4f8ad, b26cd297b19fe92f7c80a7beea28ce6b0824527f, 52713331e104325b6db2c077583b3b615bd8aff3, 840ccbf20c6724e75fc48416c480d299ecbb45bf, 6edb12158adfa01186e02ae02a7d62caa73e5f14)
- Improve settings navigation, layout, and exit handling (issue #3512 and issue #3555) (7cdc5cecd326eb41cf6d1612a5daa70c593d94b6, 5e4cad72f629ca0a7ba9069498bddfb4b7b42e71, b348f7709662ff925dd659887a114e6761db5e6d, a684f5801b6a5f948c2a3e1f86adb66c190bd455)
- Improve custom auto-complete and tag auto-add controls (issue #3565 and issue #3581) (301b769d6dfd84df39faaa3d36bcb938a6c946f0, bf6316110faa6a81457376bc1c4342cbffd108cf, 81155a49194b7319e8d626154429e26577346d36)
- Add and fix the mobile search-history screen (issue #3513) (eac3684b4c2238035efad88ed9ecb08b0018f8dc, fae555b887a62bf91328b2ca67f56762083374fa, c3124c40fdefa1e2f696f0ff4b8aec57b7f8801b)
- Improve page and numeric controls (issue #3577 and issue #3584) (6724a364417e29110bdb48b3c1cc66a43ab3bf36, 33ee547fad11a9feed82ddf50b84bbfc0095a560, a26ce8a91e009f6232fbad918b44d19bd771f051)
- Allow to export ZIP backups (issue #3578) (7a0309bbc6c3a46b4f37a9a94b7ac35f72d5c88f)
- Don't scale video overlay vertically (7080f29200d9d494499717a63f41d9439e1ce389)

## Documentation

- Update szurubooru.js (PR #3523) (c50935258d98e3097fa4955b9b8bb87ef578ff6b), thanks @sahaq!
- Various translation updates (PR #3549) (8b5a89953aa24bba3105e93fca7777777a220feb), thanks to all Crowdin contributors!
- Update szurubooru.md (PR #3575) (2dccf5bbb65a56693eb6e611194c6f5978a09d40), thanks @moonSoir!

## Technical

- Use Ubuntu 22.04 for Linux builds (PR #3454) (da8dce6ac2706a9b675b31e6eaa5d80bac64ed49), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Updated build script to match Gentoo repository changes (PR #3499) (02898867475ddb2d7eec4dfe2d7b037c6e012f97), thanks @Penguin-Guru!
- Use lzma compression when building macOS DMG (PR #3559) (6924dc6c623de3ef177806d597ac1c76ddb15fa4), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Fix Arch build script Qt package name (PR #3426) (32e50e2ebe46563f02d90bc0787e8d3d52ba0031), thanks @thegman254!
- Many other technical changes

name: v7.13.0
body:
## Features
- Allow to customize format conversion timeout (issue #3185) (b043373eb9913e2fe914199f360b8ce342dcbd38)
- Allow to keep color profile on metadata clear (issue #3166, fix #3196) (19dcd19604016be1bde81cc48961f9e1d7afdc2d)
- Replace settings by logs directory in log tab (issue #3205) (fce0186bce77c45088210a26092a6e69f572b60d)
- Add support for Exiftool sidecar files (issue #3087) (56f5a782061828ce2e32dc803640edf20df4a642)
- Update wording for buttons in log tab (PR #3219) (e5295e96f88a001bbc9987684eff2d61435dfcc4), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Detect Cloudflare redirects during image download (42755538a4321ff7ed68aebe4f1b541b0fe6638f)
- Use fps_mode instead of vsync in ffmpeg (PR #3283) (4e28e10411fd5ec78a03c9930e1c5671630cf23b), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Add Arabic, Turkish, Dutch, and Chinese Traditional languages (b287d52eb7324da792fdf1a1c251ed77968bcbb4, fb98ea35ea9bfb137ad92ca0f02e7cefa0f6cabf), thanks to all the translators on Crowdin!
- Add excluded extension feature to MD5 fixer (issue #3285) (73f6cc01b5e85eda925b945dbc8afa4746839ad2)
- Add "suffix without extension" log file path type (issue #3325) (c12fc25a6f0ae2104531c8022c34cf0c822c3cfa, fe3a514aaf4e01a5d336f0c0f18ec0517a154cdf)
- Pass dark theme information for tags in the viewer window (0fa597c8e054f7d50725d2b88108f480ea22cb9c)
- Add grabber_branch and grabber_version tokens (issue #3188) (708e959f7c969d117b77df988970097fa65b6bd3)
- Add new %ratio% token (issue #3275) (d9f0c272d4c529f11b8318e6d80232ea1295948f, 64499c8ce1e2caa96f0bf86614a9e8a4ee434d36)

## Fixes
- Crash when pausing downloads (issue #3180) (001526db069837d9231a7d088420751bf5cb96f5)
- Don't crash on Ctrl+W tab (issue #3178) (90f12749fd2e22aa79072f64fc270f22a55b941d)
- Don't close image window on tags middle click (issue #3160) (d16bfb04db5477b0c5b69cfd28da1636fb3fd882)
- Get file extension from header when enabled (issue #3158) (93dd9304a3f9e420a189a3634dd41d06334f54a0, 5dcf26d38365b982b39a432af2bd12eae295caf5)
- Convert images via ffmpeg instead of trying to remux (521e987fd17f28e380f7e02243d832c0fa83d821)
- Use correct URL for Google reverse image search (issue #3212) (343f7cb696ad02796dbb2a951b27304ad3b06fe1)
- Ignore minor Exiftool errors to allow writing to JXL (issue #3213) (147bf3406ce9fc5fb7d3833e8c11e2c829e64241), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Improve automatic thumbnail choice (issue #3230) (f95c659e442a711258ad996379472624796436f0)
- Properly destroy profile and exiftool process on close (issue #3231) (80bb6abf967a2cf5a8568b0ad93308e7764beb38)
- Properly encode animated and transparent WEBP (PR #3233) (5fc472d8de26cd49a2b203682bf4e14043ed237d), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Ignore empty args when splitting commands (issue #3239) (b34eb952141faca68b6dae1f359a999d40a04c10)
- Use correct 0-1 scale for volume instead of 0-100 (issue #3242) (1b570b3eb58b3528f7b199ca613ad27e91fa9eb7)
- Fix invalid OpenSSL version used in portable releases (issue #3244) (4f5b880ad1e2d833632385ae5e4d15e7e10bdaa0)
- Properly register button settings type (issue #3071) (eac529ae28324328b2b7bacd2de1e82ff9d60f5e)
- Re-add rating in danbooru.js script (PR #3276) (bd314e4c8605813a86a562f4a9c162d01fc4e22e), thanks @Eddyall-1!
- Add NetworkAuth dependency in gui (PR #3259) (1e892c557c6d76de6581be7ceb021d127598e5f2), thanks @renesat!
- Use XDG_RUNTIME_DIR on Unix for temporary files (issue #3294) (5b15546aca64f951599337477ab5d0eeec38dbe2)
- Properly use default value for rating token (issue #3327) (7bef22aa62e937f8522f85b96de27a280b55cb2c)
- Remember MD5 list fixer tool window size and fix warnings (issue #3316) (ffbd707b6bb5c4c7c3cfd0eae6b3b3c82e961418)
- Remove "{%UserProfile}\Grabber" from the uninstaller (PR #3347) (885f6e81bf6654cc1c168b4dc3f8c28ce4e1a025), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Stop crashing on close due to double profile clean-up (1dfec4d7d05f51000eeaf91aa11373b512b0bab7)
- Properly pass cookies to sub-domains (issue #3225) (64508708b34fa76ec66f4c7f191175987e8fe7af)

## Sources
- Set default intervals to 1s for image, page, and details (PR #3221) (722e9c8eb9258b96ee244dad7abb495760ec73a3), thanks @ProtagNeptune!
- Fix Anime-Pictures API URL (issue #3225) (ff5ca6c2bcf8db36e6a71dbe61df224cef3a293e)
- Fix Gelbooru 0.2 HTML image list parsing (605538789be61453e312875f2c2239c7a1f139fa)
- Add JS flag for translated tags in Pixiv (issue #2535) (336e20c3904f1b05e0aa8999696cf1f86f529aee, 0e952dfe141dad6b95a3e667aa8eb21e53320789)
- Remove Twitter from the default install (issue #3287) (3ace8fa52ada667b3cba5e43d539b2aaab3d32a2)
- Fix "order:random" not working on E621 (issue #3353) (6c4e4b64c717eab3370e3c459da76e592848c378)
- Fix webp support for NHentai (PR #3323) (12b50c84f8676cb9b70f62f54327e92059c96ae0), thanks @Eliolocin!
- Fix R34.us detail tag parsing (issue #3352) (d8d8de7cd5ec051b2e246fd9a32f703d0aa083b9)
- Exclude "Hentai Cosplays" from ZIP releases (issue #3250) (4f26ea7673ea5acab8d0c1e3d046050b8cf5ac57)
- Add category support for WallHaven (PR #3247) (572e2a486a63edbfa4b05d7dd9e904fe9de3c7de), thanks @KAGEYAM4!

## Android
- Include SQL driver in Android builds (issue #3167) (40ee2786255b35b25a35bf8b544b83c1a2b7706f)
- Don't crash when adding favorites from tag view (issue #3191) (51ae3313a1390a3344b5ba326c9cc7218181d42b)
- Add sorting by name to favorites view (issue #3192) (3fcab0a388610eaf8c473bab993f8183b91c4926)

name: v7.12.2
body:
## Changes from 7.12.2
- Don't crash when closing tabs with the small "x" icon (e805e7c1a11c905b614e4a6b41c106d2a9c8616b)

-----

## Changes from 7.12.1

-----

## Sources
- Add support for "lore" tag on e621 (issue #3059) (9a2ec55048c9f8fbd8cf0da1771d0c32a6312046)

name: Tag databases
body:
Those files are tag databases used to prevent doing too many requests on sources.
They are automatically generated and contain all tags with more than 100 images at the time of the generation.

To use them, rename them to `tags.db` and move them to:
```
C:/Users/%USERNAME%/AppData/Local/Bionus/Grabber/sites/%SOURCE_NAME%/%SITE_DOMAIN%/tags.db
```

Note that not all sources require a tag database as they might already provide the tag type information in the listing API.
